name: @awacloud/fw-wasm-crypto
description: Supply-chain-isolated WebAssembly crypto for @awacloud/fw: 17 wasm modules (AES, ChaCha20-Poly1305, SHA-2/3, BLAKE2b, HMAC/HKDF/PBKDF2/Argon2, RSA, ECC, Ed25519/X25519, ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA) built from own C23 sources and committed vendored bases, with a browser loader and a provenance validator.

awa._coverageComment: Basis = the package's own JS surface (src/loader.js, src/provenance.js). The canonical All-files aggregate is dominated by collateral this package's KAT harness imports by design (tools/wasm-crypto build tooling) and by gitignored generated dist/*.wasm.js glue, so it tracks whether dist/ is built rather than tests; the floor is seeded max(0, floor(basis mean) - 2) from the src/** basis measured at declaration. Never seed from the unfiltered aggregate.

author: Matthieu Bouilloux
